title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: protect unsaved content from printing, USB and network shares (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the launched roadmap item from Learn's continuing statement that unsaved files cannot be inspected. The licensing, platform qualifications and documented rule command are supported; the admin path needs a minor expansion to reach an individual activity restriction.

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP extends Purview DLP activity monitoring and protection to onboarded Windows and macOS devices.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches Apply restrictions to specific activity in a device policy rule.
claims.quote: Select the Custom from the Categories then Custom policy template from Regulations. ... Scope the location to Devices only. ... In Actions: ... Select Audit or restrict activities on devices. ... Select Apply restrictions to specific activity
claims.fix: Expand controls[0].ui.path and its rendered copy to 'Data Loss Prevention > Policies > Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > Admin units > Full directory > Devices > rule > Actions > Audit or restrict activities on devices > Apply restrictions to specific activity > Copy to a removable USB device > Block with override'. This is the USB restriction route given at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-edlp-scan-fails; the same page separately documents Copy to a network share > Block with override.
